title: Paging for EPS services through E-UTRAN using IMSI

entities.name: Paging for EPS services using IMSI
entities.description: An abnormal procedure used for error recovery in the network when S-TMSI is not available. The network initiates paging with CN domain indicator set to PS.

entities.name: Paging
entities.description: Paging message sent from network to UE for EPS services using IMSI.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE in response to paging using IMSI to initiate attach procedure.

entities.name: IMSI
entities.description: International Mobile Subscriber Identity used for paging when S-TMSI is unavailable.

entities.name: CN domain indicator
entities.description: Set to PS for paging for EPS services.

entities.name: T3346
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon reception of paging using IMSI.

entities.name: T3396
entities.description: All running instances stopped by UE upon reception of paging using IMSI.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State entered by UE after local detach from EPS upon paging using IMSI.

entities.name: Local detach from EPS
entities.description: Action performed by UE upon paging using IMSI: deactivate EPS bearers, delete parameters, set update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE after local detach in response to paging using IMSI.

relations.description: Paging procedure includes sending Paging message.
Paging message uses IMSI for identification.
Paging message includes CN domain indicator set to PS.
Paging procedure triggers UE to perform local detach.
Local detach stops timer T3346 if running.
Local detach stops all running T3396 timers.
Local detach changes UE state to EMM-DEREGISTERED.
Paging procedure leads to UE performing attach procedure.
Attach procedure includes sending ATTACH REQUEST message.
